Streaming chat completion via the Google Vertex AI provider using the vertex_ai/ prefix — verifies SSE chunks from the Gemini streaming endpoint are yielded and assembled correctly

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { Message, createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.chatStream({ maxTokens: 32, messages: [{ role: "user", user: { content: "Count to three, one word per response." } } as Message], model: "vertex_ai/gemini-2.0-flash", stream: true });
  for await (const resultChunk of result) {
    console.log(resultChunk);
  }
}

void main();
```
